My Guys Were not. 🤣🤣🤣

  


  



Willie Ross Jr. Knee Deep (@RossKneeDeep)

Quite often, I get a little hurt when I find out that people I liked and admired were actually racists.





— https://nitter.net/RossKneeDeep/status/2052749602583888178#m

Um Cooking


 (@)

The people are waiting for another classic 🔥



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052877856108171725#m
Yo Grandma 👵🏻 too. Old heaux 🤣

🤣🤣🤣🤣 Boy U Cold.  That was a Barber Shop Talk Worthy One 🤣🤣🤣


 (@)

Today his payoff would be a Black Gender Studies PhD and a podcast.



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052801712918807039#m

My baby mama be like........... (🤣🤣🤣)

All Jokes aside tho.  Um solid and wish u well on your campaign.

I will keep my Focus on Georgia as we have @ossoff @KeishaBottoms and other Dem's I believe in pushing to win there.

#DontDie (Killer Mike Classic)


 (@)

Sad we lost @KillerMike
He ain’t dead he just not like us.



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052853427017764950#m

Get Well Brother Fred!!!!


 (@)

I'm feeling it brother ❤️



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052848119763669499#m

U gotta!!!!


 (@)

Need to pull up to Bankhead Seafood. That fish sammich looks incredible.



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052809705924210734#m

Lord. Calm his spirit.  Cover him in this time of worry and stress.  Be his healer and protector in uncertainty.  Bring this brother back to his family healthy and healed. Amen


 (@)

Is it too forward to ask if you'd say a prayer for me. In the ER with chest pains 😔





— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052836461238505500#m

Man, I'm on the track with @WeAreDeLaSoul 

U cannot tell my 16 year old self, shit! 
Life goal accomplished & all becuz my Mommy encouraged me to be an Emcee!  Thank U Denise.


 (@)

Just in time for #MothersDay ❤️ @WeAreDeLaSoul release the official music video for “16 For Mama” feat. @KillerMike

From the latest album, #CabinInTheSky. Watch now: piped.video/PVl3snQ794M?si=CL-n…

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052843793498693974#m

I was so damn happy when we heard u won! We deserved black man!


 (@)

I just won a Grammy. I have friends that I came up wit that have won Oscars. None of us thought we would be here but look at God! You cant tell me that you cant dream bigger! You can…and you should!





— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052801919970587113#m

#TheSWAGshop in State Farm Arena will be open.  Umma watch Games from there.  Ya'll come support our squad




Atlanta Dream (@AtlantaDream)

For the ones who built the culture.​
For the city that inspires everything.​
From the city. For the city. Homegrown Rebel Jersey.​

Shop now: dreamatl.net/49yULkk

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/AtlantaDream/status/2052756630354190562#m

🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾


Be A King (@BerniceKing)

Ahmaud Arbery should have turned 32 years old today.

But he never made it to 26.

I am thinking of his family today, and of every family forced to carry the weight of a loved one’s stolen future.

Please keep Ahmaud’s family in your prayers. And may we remain committed to justice, truth, and creating a world where Black lives are not treated as disposable.

#AhmaudArbery #Justice #BelovedCommunity





— https://nitter.net/BerniceKing/status/205271256678311978

Sent two Dem senators to DC.  @ReverendWarnock & @ossoff & helped Another Dem Atlanta Mayor in @andreforatlanta. 

All 3 of these guys have done a stellar job leading in Georgia. 

If those are "issues" and I was head of the DNC I'd ask Mike to Run.  

Oh wow look a here.  Me and the leader of the DNC.   

🫡😉




 (@)

So you clearly don’t see the issues that killer Mike caused the Democratic Party last election and the issues that when you see Black people like Nick Cannon say what he said yeah

All the time!!! GM


 (@)

Gm God is good



— https://nitter.net/i/status/2052728603310243854#m

Love their story


SKI (@skiistiredasf)

Winchel and Felicia Elibert, a dynamic Black couple from Fayetteville, Georgia, made history by opening Kingdom Corners, the city’s first Black-owned shopping plaza. The 15,000-square-foot development on New Hope Road is now fully leased and home to several Black-owned businesses





— https://nitter.net/skiistiredasf/status/2052510170215776369#m

Proud of Bro!!!


FOX 5 Atlanta (@FOX5Atlanta)

Big Boi is serving as an executive producer on a new documentary about the 1996 Olympic Games in Atlanta. fox5atlanta.com/news/big-boi…




— https://nitter.net/FOX5Atlanta/status/2052611982121894109#m

@theswagshopedgewood has always been about more than cuts — it’s about community. Atlanta helped us establish roots, and now we’re honoring those same values as we grow. Big love to @Square for being part of the journey. #ad

I woke up with ‘Mania on my Mind. This beat is so cold I had to kill it. Don’t trip Cody, minor setback for a major comeback and congrats to Jey for getting his first World Title! Inspired By Old Atlanta & TBS! #wrestling #codyrhodes #jeyuso #rap #atlanta
Had to get bro right before his show in the A tomorrow @Tommy Richman
Super rare throwback #netflix #comedy #triggerwarning
To laugh at another man’s fault is to make their same mistake yourself..#addiction #killamike #runthejewels
Outside w the legends! #wwe
Out here #wwe
Shoutout my boy stacks! #andre3000 #scientistsandengineers #grammy #rap
